outcomes: A Rush monorepo is read as its Rush projects, each a component named by its directory and its package name, from rush.json
Each Rush project lists the Rush projects it depends on, so a change to one project names the projects that depend on it
The lockfile Rush keeps under common/config, and each subspace lockfile, is read as the repository's dependency changes
nonGoals: Running rush, pnpm, npm or yarn, or reading common/temp or node_modules
Computing the changed and dependent components, the tests and coverage per component and the dependency changes: the change analyses own them
Reading Rush command-line, version policy or build cache configuration

text: A root rush.json, JSON with comments, makes a Rush monorepo.
Each entry of its projects list is a component of source orchestrator and ecosystem node, its id its projectFolder, its name its packageName.
An entry without a name, with a folder that is absolute, the root or outside the repository, or with a folder or name an earlier entry took, is a diagnostic and is left out.
A rush.json that cannot be read or parsed is a warning and gives no component, so the other detectors answer.

A Rush project depends on another when one of the dependencies, devDependencies, optionalDependencies or peerDependencies of its package.json names that project with the workspace: protocol, an alias included, or with a version range that project's version satisfies.
A dependency whose key the project lists in decoupledLocalDependencies or cyclicDependencyProjects is no edge.
A package.json that cannot be read is a diagnostic: its project stays a component without edges.
The package manager rush.json names selects the lockfile: pnpmVersion common/config/rush/pnpm-lock.yaml, npmVersion common/config/rush/npm-shrinkwrap.json, yarnVersion common/config/rush/yarn.lock.
In pnpm mode, each common/config/subspaces/<name>/pnpm-lock.yaml is a lockfile too.
The existing pnpm, npm and yarn readers read them; Rush's temporary projects, named @rush-temp/, and file: or link: packages are no dependency.

requirements.text: On a Rush monorepo, putnami observe summarizes the Rush projects and their edges, marks a project that depends on a changed one dependent and the others unaffected, and lists the version changes of the Rush lockfile among the dependency changes.
